system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template creating a service account for a Cloud Function that needs to read from a specific Cloud Storage bucket.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template creating a service account for a Cloud Function that needs to read from a specific Cloud Storage bucket.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: cloud-function-service-account
  type: iam.v1.serviceAccount
  properties:
    accountId: cf-storage-reader-sa
    displayName: Service Account for Cloud Function Storage Reader
    projectId: {{ env['project'] }}

- name: storage-bucket-reader-role
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.roles
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ env['project'] }}
    roleId: customStorageObjectViewer
    role:
      title: Custom Storage Object Viewer
      description: Custom role to read objects from specific bucket
      includedPermissions:
        - storage.objects.get
        - storage.objects.list

- name: service-account-storage-policy
  type: gcp-types/storage-v1:buckets/setIamPolicy
  properties:
    bucket: $(ref.cloud-storage-bucket.name)
    project: {{ env['project'] }}
    bindings:
      - role: roles/storage.objectViewer
        members:
          - serviceAccount: $(ref.cloud-function-service-account.email)
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
      - cloud-function-service-account

- name: service-account-key
  type: iam.v1.serviceAccount.key
  properties:
    parent: $(ref.cloud-function-service-account.name)
    keyAlgorithm: KEY_ALG_RSA_2048
    privateKeyType: TYPE_GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS_FILE
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
      - cloud-function-service-account

outputs:
- name: serviceAccountEmail
  value: $(ref.cloud-function-service-account.email)
- name: serviceAccountKey
  value: $(ref.service-account-key.privateKeyData)
